title: Accounting for VAT
overview: With the anticipated implementation of a unified Value Added Tax (VAT) framework across GCC states starting January 1, 2018, this course provides the essential guidance needed to ensure a smooth transition for your organization. Participants will learn how to direct accounting, finance, IT, business development, and other relevant departments toward successful VAT adoption.

This program introduces the fundamental terms, principles, and mechanics of VAT as expected to be applied in the GCC. It also prepares your accounting staff to fully understand and correctly manage VAT processes, from invoicing and recording entries to preparing VAT return forms. Participants will gain practical insights into the accounting treatment of VAT for various goods and services.
audience: This course is designed for professionals such as staff accountants, senior accountants, chief accountants, accounting managers, controllers, internal auditors, tax consultants, tax preparers, IT professionals, business development managers, and others involved in company operations across various departments.
methodology: This course incorporates a blend of interactive methods, including concise presentations, practical applications of theoretical concepts, and group exercises to foster knowledge exchange and hands-on learning.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define key VAT terms such as taxable persons, input VAT, output VAT, and exempt supplies.
Assess the impact of VAT adoption on their organization’s financial statements.
Account for VAT on the purchase and sale of goods and services, whether VAT-registered or not.
Utilize the company’s trial balance to complete VAT return forms.
Conduct a preliminary assessment of VAT’s impact on operations and accounts.
Evaluate the effects of VAT implementation across specific industries.
